parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of the trashcan is a small metallic lever located at the bottom front, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to open the lid of the trashcan by pressing it with the foot, allowing hands-free operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a downward direction when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular metallic cover that seals the top of the trashcan, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and opens when the foot pad is pressed, providing access to the interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge when the foot pad is pressed and closes automatically when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the trashcan, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and foot mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
